stage: development protocol; no claim of preregistration
target: current SOC estimation (not future SOC forecasting, SOH or RUL)
nasa_status: conditional extension; excluded until suitable SOC reference and inputs are audited
reference: tester charge counters anchored at full CCCV; Qref from separate initial-capacity run; not independently measured ground truth
reference_quality_gate: exclude windows containing reconstructed SOC outside [0,1]; preserve raw labels and report exclusion counts; do not clip targets; no claim about complete cutoff-to-cutoff SOC accuracy
reference_limitation: fixed initial calibration capacity gives negative end-of-discharge references in some 25/45 C records; this is a reference-definition limitation, not proof of sensor errors; temperature-dependent capacity sensitivity requires further validation
cross_temperature_extension: train DST at 0/45 C, validate FUDS at 0/45 C, test US06/BJDST at held-out 25 C; separate training run
normalization: fit pooled training records only; reused for validation and testing
aggregation: equal-weight record macro-average, with per-record metrics retained; same target times for every model
tuning_policy: validation only; no model chosen or tuned by test errors
pilot: 25 C, one seed, five epochs; training and validation only; no test metrics
claims_boundary: one cell; ambient temperature not cell temperature; no hardware/BMS validation; reconstructed reference uncertainty
